The initiative aims to protect a significant portion of the ocean while promoting local leadership and community involvement. Additionally, international waters will also benefit from proposed marine protected areas.

title: Straitcraft: How geography gives Iran leverage and could do the same for India

This has resulted in a marked decline in oil flows, affecting the global economy and forcing the US to reconsider its stance. Concurrently, India is exploring ways to capitalize on its geographical advantages against China.

title: Colorado couple closes family restaurant after 31 years as children build careers

Jose and Maria Caballero are now closing the Fort Collins restaurant, saying they have achieved the dream that brought them to the US: giving their children the chance to build independent lives and careers outside the family business.

title: Nokia closes China research hub; recalls CEO’s Huawei warning to Europe

The closure revives CEO Justin Hotard's pointed question to Europe: why does Huawei still run nearly 60% of Germany's 5G sites while Nokia holds under 3% share in China? Restructuring charges have tripled to €800 million, even as AI and cloud orders surge 105%.

title: Michael Tilson Thomas bought SF mansion for $1.4m; 32 years later, it asks $10m

The mansion was a sanctuary for the musician and his husband Joshua Robison for nearly three decades. Built in 1906, the four-level home features a blend of architectural styles and modern amenities added over the years. Its spacious rooms hosted numerous distinguished guests from the music and architecture worlds.

title: Alonzo Mourning’s $37.4M affordable housing project offers $322 senior homes

Through collaboration with Housing Trust Group, he has spearheaded various projects, including the Astoria on 9th, which boasts 120 affordable apartments in Bradenton. This incident has raised concerns over the reliability of the Election Commission's ECINet software, prompting criticism from opposition parties about electoral registration procedures and centralization.

Rajnath Singh

NEW DELHI: Defence minister Rajnath Singh said Thursday India articulated its new policy against terrorism through Op Sindoor, adding that "any terror attack originating from Pakistani soil will be considered an 'act of war' and those contemplating any form of misadventure will be met with deserving response". Speaking at the News18 Defcon 2026, Rajnath said, "We've made it clear that the nation possesses both 'power of argument' and 'argument of power', and we will communicate through whichever language the other party understands best. Today, while we work towards establishing global peace, we are simultaneously strengthening our defence capabilities to counter any threat. Events such as surgical strikes, Balakot strike and Op Sindoor demonstrated that we possess the capability to safeguard our interests. "

End of Article

title: Restored Frank Lloyd Wright home now earns up to $200,000 a year
content: the 2,500-square-foot Frank Lloyd Wright home is now back in the spotlight after a careful restoration . the sprawling 70-acre community conceived by the celebrated architect as an intimate experiment in Usonian living . a rare Wright community The Acres is considered the only community composed entirely of Frank Lloyd .

title: NEET-PG 2026 result out: 2.65 lakh candidates appeared, General cut-off at 262
content: the result includes candidates' raw scores and overall NEET-PG ranks . the qualifying level was 50th percentile, with cut-off score at 262 marks out of 720 this year . for general and EWS categories, qualifying levels were 50th, 45th, 40th and 226 marks for SC, ST and OBC candidates .

title: SIR row: EC says Form 6, 8 with citizenship declaration were unanimously approved
content: special intensive revision orders related to Phase 1 in Bihar, Phase 2 in a dozen states/UTs and ongoing Phase 3 in 19 states/us have all listed Forms 6 and 8 with a mandatory declaration form on citizenship details of the elector or parents . EC sources also denied ECINET was locking out field officers like electoral registration officers, assistant EROs, BLOs, DEOs, and chief electoral officers .

title: Rs 94,000 crore looted by Dubai-based scammers: CBI arrests key Mahadev app accused
content: abhishek Kumar was deported from the UAE and taken into custody by CBI immediately after arriving from Dubai . he was close to main accused Saurabh Chandrakar and Shubham Soni - both continue to operate the gambling network .

title: TMC factional row: SC asks EC for timeframe to decide party name, symbol dispute
content: former CM Mamata Banerjee challenged EC's interim order freezing the party symbol . a bench of chief justice and justices said early adjudication was desirable . the poll panel could conduct day-to-day hearings .

title: 8 years of Ayushman Bharat: 60 crore beneficiaries, Rs 2 lakh crore in treatment
content: ayushman Bharat has transformed healthcare access for millions and described it as the world's largest health assurance scheme . he highlighted the Rs 5 lakh annual health cover available to more than 60 crore people and said the scheme enabled savings on medical expenses, benefiting poor and middle-class families .

title: ‘No greater partner than Trump’: Netanyahu defends Iran war as delegates walk out at UNGA
content: the speech was marked by a walkout by dozens of delegates as he took the podium . he responded by calling those who left 'moral cowards' and continued his address to a hall . supporters cheered and applauded Netanyahu during parts of the speech .

title: BJP spent Rs 287 crore in Bengal polls, over half its five-state election bill
content: BJP spent more than 54% of its total expenditure of Rs 529 crore in five assembly elections earlier this year . BJP trumped the governing TMC in Bengal, bagging 207 of the 293 seats while Trinamool managed 80 .

title: Centre moves SC for 2-year window to implement OBC creamy layer verdict
content: govt says retrospective application of a changed eligibility criterion may unsettle appointments and admissions . the ruling made the verdict implementable from 2012, when the case was first filed . court had in march held that the income of parents could not be the sole criteria .

title: EC eyes October electoral roll revision across poll-bound states
content: EC is likely to order special summary revision (SSR) of electoral rolls in poll-bound UP, Uttarakhand, Punjab, Goa and Manipur in Oct . but it is unlikely to go for a nationwide SSR this year in view of SIR Phase 3 underway in 19 states/UTs and the ongoing Census exercise . sources said SIR was underway towards the end of 2025 in a dozen states and had been completed only a few months ago in Bihar.

title: Trump hosts Xi at White House state dinner with tech, finance heavy guest list
content: Xi and Trump entered the white house ahead of a state dinner in washington . both leaders are expected to deliver remarks before joining guests for a meal featuring squash, wild mushrooms and crispy pancetta . among the high-profile technology executives attending are apple CEO Tim Cook, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg, Zoom CEO Eric Yuan and TikTok investor Jeff Yass .
